evals.prompt: Install ESLint globally so I can use it in this repository. The repository already has pnpm-lock.yaml.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes one-bin, refuses an unnecessary global install, uses the repository's pnpm owner, and proposes a project-local dependency or pnpm exec route.

evals.prompt: Install ripgrep for the whole machine and make sure every terminal uses it.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes one-bin, audits existing rg candidates, chooses declarative Nix in dotfiles, validates a Darwin build, refreshes a shell, and verifies the selected real path without creating npm or Bun globals.

evals.prompt: I installed the same CLI with npm, Bun, and Nix, but command -v still points to npm. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes one-bin audit exe, identifies every owner in PATH order, verifies the Nix replacement before asking to remove obsolete npm and Bun owners, refreshes the shell, and confirms one canonical target.

evals.prompt: Add a dependency to this new personal TypeScript project. It has package.json but no lockfile or packageManager field.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes one-bin decide, confirms the project is genuinely new and personal, defaults to Bun, and creates only bun.lock.

evals.prompt: Put this direct-download macOS app under Homebrew management without losing its data.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes one-bin, audits current provenance and ownership, does not force Homebrew adoption, presents a deliberate one-owner migration with data preservation and App Management checks, and requires approval before removal.
